headline: RFP — Tween / Teen Maker Spot
lead: Open solicitation for a spot vendor to run maker / challenge / hang activities for ages ~11–17 at Elk Grove Lunar New Year 2027 — not Children’s Village. Toy Drive 2026 optional this season.

meta.description: Request for proposals: tween/teen Maker Spot vendor for Elk Grove Lunar New Year 2027. Photo-worthy DIY and challenges for ages 11–17. Proposals due Nov 21, 2026.

statusLine: Open for proposals · Due Fri Nov 21, 2026 · First event EGLNY Feb 2027

related.label: Related lots
related.text: Children’s Theater and Children’s Village are separate RFPs for younger cohorts. You may bid more than one lot; awards may split.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: cPALSs seeks a spot vendor to run a tween / teen Maker Spot — table and booth activities with status: photo-worthy DIY, scored or crew challenges, peer hang — so roughly ages 11–17 have something to do that isn’t little-kid craft land.
This is not Children’s Village. Do not brand, sign, or staff it as a kids village.
The festival keeps map placement, seasonal skins, and adjacency rules. You own the activity menu, staffing, and day-of run.
Primary audience: roughly ages 11–17. Younger kids may wander through; do not redesign the spot for ages 2–10.

sections.title: Events in scope

rows: Weekend footprint (dry days; rain cancels the park day)
Optional this season — slim maker / challenge pocket if you bid the add-on
Slim maker / challenge pocket when that festival returns

bullets: Season note: Toy Drive 2026 is optional. In following seasons we expect to require (or strongly prefer) Maker Spot on the Toy Drive celebration as well.
Out of scope: Children’s Village · Children’s Theater · carnival rides / bounce houses · hiring for Moditional Dance Battle, Meme Dance Contest, or Spirit Break / main-stage culture shows.

orderedItems.label: Activity menu
orderedItems.text: Fit for ages ~11–17 (maker / challenge / hang — not preschool make-and-take).

orderedItems.label: Adaptation plan
orderedItems.text: How you’d skin it for Tết (EGLNY) and later lantern season.

orderedItems.label: Compliance & references
orderedItems.text: Insurance · W-9 · references (festival or school / youth events preferred).

orderedItems.label: Quotes
orderedItems.text: A — EGLNY 2027 only. B — EGLNY 2027 + next GLF (preferred for a repeating festival lane). Optional — Toy Drive 2026 add-on (not required to win A or B).

sections.title: Product rules
bullets: No “Children’s Village” naming on wayfinding, shirts, or social.
Peer / crew energy over parent-led craft circle.
Prefer photo-worthy, keepable, or challenge outcomes.
Volunteers (especially high school students) will typically be available from the festival side. You may deploy them or staff with your own crew — using them is optional.
Freemium is preferred (free core activities with optional purchasable enhancements), but not exclusively required. Guests must still be able to start a core activity without a paywall.
Coordinate map adjacency with Program; do not own Moditional stage cues.

rows: Menu proven with tweens/teens (not only preschool craft catalogs)
Staffing reliability · insurance · outdoor festival logistics
Local Sacramento / Elk Grove corridor · school or youth-org experience
Ability to grow to peer festivals

sections.title: How to respond
paragraphs: Email your proposal to contact@cpalss.com with subject: cPALSs Tween/Teen Maker Spot RFP.
Include: company overview · activity menu · footprint · staffing · quote table (A/B) · insurance summary · references.
Questions before the proposal deadline: same inbox, same subject line with — question appended.

contact.title: Submit a proposal
contact.intro: Prefer email. Attach PDFs or links; keep proposals readable.
